assets.fit: Contain in a square frame; cropping risks cutting the wordmark near the lower edge
assets.surfaceReview: Orange wordmark reads on both specimens; dark navy linework is weak on dark surfaces and the black field is a hard rectangle on light surfaces
assets.responsiveReview: Keep square and avoid narrow logo lockups; do not use as a tiny favicon or text replacement

assets.responsiveReview: Avoid small responsive placements because the checkerboard pattern becomes visual noise
